problem: An old service reference can allocate after service withdrawal; directory preparation and provider startup can outlive withdrawal and publish another child without the original lifetime owner. Caller cancellation racing provider publication also needs resource rollback before refusal.
fix: Runtime-owned admission closes once. Each pending operation has its own cancellation controller and non-rejecting completion. Withdrawal cancels those controllers and joins completions before draining adopted failures. One-shot directory/provider startup combines caller cancellation with that operation signal; a provider publication received after cancellation is disposed and failed rollback is retained. Successful catalog commit releases runtime cancellation before synchronous lifecycle observers, keeping published holder-owned runs and caller cancellation intact.
